## How it works

- [statement] Lo, Mamaysky and Wang (2000) report incremental information in several technical indicators when comparing conditional and unconditional daily US stock return distributions. (low confidence) — https://web.mit.edu/wangj/www/pap/LoMamayskyWang00.pdf

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Lo, Mamaysky and Wang (2000) and Savin, Weller and Zvingelis (2006 manuscript) use algorithmic technical-pattern recognition based on kernel regression in US equity studies. (low confidence) — https://web.mit.edu/wangj/www/pap/LoMamayskyWang00.pdf · keywords: Causal price-action geometry · also: https://www.biz.uiowa.edu/faculty/gsavin/papers/hsrevision_paw_10%2019%2006.pdf
- [statement] Kim, Koh, Boyd and Gorinevsky (2009) explicitly describe l1 trend filtering as a batch method estimating a trend from the whole history of observations. (low confidence) — https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/papers/pdf/l1_trend_filter.pdf
- [statement] Kim, Koh, Boyd and Gorinevsky (2009) state that l1 trend filtering produces piecewise-linear trend estimates and interpret slope changes as possible changes or events in underlying dynamics. (low confidence) — https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/papers/pdf/l1_trend_filter.pdf
- [statement] For S&P 500 stocks in 1990–1999, Savin, Weller and Zvingelis report no evidence that a stand-alone head-and-shoulders trading strategy would be profitable; their corresponding Russell 2000 evidence is weak. (low confidence) — https://www.biz.uiowa.edu/faculty/gsavin/papers/hsrevision_paw_10%2019%2006.pdf
- [statement] Lo, Mamaysky and Wang report incremental conditional-return information for some algorithmically detected chart patterns, while explicitly distinguishing this from excess trading profits. (low confidence) — https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w7613/w7613.pdf
- [statement] Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen report return persistence at intermediate horizons with partial longer-horizon reversal in their August 2010 time-series momentum draft. (low confidence) — https://elmwealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/timeseriesmomentum.pdf
